source_metadata.notes: Executable reference subset of the PBMA-versus-beef identity-gap panel. The current runtime surface closes only the furfural excess marker directly, using a glucose-plus-cysteine free-precursor surrogate that is already benchmarked by the engine; diacetyl, acetoin, and 2-acetylpyrrole remain attached in the intake metadata until broader mixed-matrix coverage is available.

metadata.notes: Free-precursor executable reference subset for the Resconi 2023 PBMA browning gap. Uses the absolute PBMA midpoint furfural value as the executable benchmark marker while the broader mixed-matrix comparator remains in intake metadata. The surrogate chemistry envelope is intentionally carbonyl-loaded relative to the generic glucose-cysteine benchmark so the executable subset represents the over-browned PBMA state rather than a generic model-system load.

citation_provenance: Resconi et al. (2023 / PMC10096055) commercial PBMA versus beef survey
Midpoint PBMA furfural value extracted from the absolute ng/g cooked-product table
matrix_ranking_contract.notes: Executable external benchmark subset for the over-browned PBMA signature. The surrogate intentionally uses a higher glucose load to represent the PBMA carbonyl burden that drives the reported furfural excess, while the broader diacetyl, acetoin, and pyrrole contrasts remain in intake metadata until the mixed-matrix comparator surface is wider.
